verdict.rationale: Drata's v2 API reference is hosted under developers.drata.com/openapi/reference/v2/ and covers many resource tags (Controls, Policies, Personnel, Risks, and others). That strongly suggests the docs are generated from an OpenAPI spec. However, no evidence shows a downloadable spec file or a download link, and probes of common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented downloadable OpenAPI/JSON/YAML file or link, a confirmed working spec URL, and independent corroboration that the spec can be fetched.
